N1.text: I make videos in Korean. That was me in English, Hindi and Chinese. I never recorded those lines. VibeRick Dub did, in my own voice, from one YouTube link. Creators who add dubbed audio already get over a quarter of their watch time from other languages. But today that means translators, voice actors, re-timing and subtitles, for every language.

verdict.heard: I make videos in Korean. That was me in English, Hindi and Chinese. I never recorded those lines. VibeRick Dub did, in my own voice, from one YouTube link. Creators who add dubbed audio already get over a quarter of their watch time from other languages. But today that means translators, voice actors, re-timing and subtitles, for every language.

N2.text: Paste a link and choose up to four of a hundred and twenty-five languages. A Cloud Run job starts, and you watch the agent work. Google's Chirp 3 speech model timestamps every word. Gemini is multimodal, so it listens to the audio itself: it fixes the transcript, hears who is speaking and casts a matching voice for each speaker, and translates every sentence to fit its time.

verdict.heard: Paste a link and choose up to four of 125 languages. A Cloud Run job starts, and you watch the agent work. Google's Chirp 3 speech model timestamps every word. Gemini is multimodal, so it listens to the audio itself: it fixes the transcript, hears who is speaking and casts a matching voice for each speaker, and translates every sentence to fit its time.

N3.text: It handles conversations too. Here is NASA's podcast, dubbed into Hindi. Gemini hears two different people and gives each one a matching voice. Nobody's voice is cloned without consent.

verdict.heard: It handles conversations too. Here is NASA's podcast dubbed into Hindi. Gemini hears two different people and gives each one a matching voice. Nobody's voice is cloned without consent.

N4.text: But how do you know a dub is right? Gemini listens to every line the agent made: the right language, every word, the right length. Here it heard my company's name come out as "WhyBrick". The agent spoke the line again, listened again, and it was fixed. Whatever it can't fix, it flags for a human.

verdict.heard: But how do you know a dub is right? Gemini listens to every line the agent made: the right language, every word, the right length. Here it heard my company's name come out as WhyBrick. The agent spoke the line again, listened again, and it was fixed. Whatever it can't fix, it flags for a human.

N5.text: And you stay in control of each line. Here I want the Hindi to say "today", so I add the word and preview just that line in the same voice. Gemini checks it again, and I accept. Only that line is regenerated; the rest of the dub stays as it was.

verdict.heard: And you stay in control of each line. Here, I want the Hindi to say "today". So I add the word, and preview just that line in the same voice. Gemini checks it again, and I accept. Only that line is regenerated. The rest of the dub stays as it was.

N6.text: It is all Google Cloud. Firebase hosts the studio. Cloud Run starts one job per dub, so it scales with creators and costs nothing when idle. Every agent decision streams through Firestore, and the media lands in Cloud Storage. On a full fifteen-minute video, three hundred sixty-six of three hundred sixty-nine lines passed the listening check, at about three cents per dubbed minute.

N7.text: Any video. A hundred and twenty-five languages. Your own voice. You make the video. VibeRick Dub takes it to the world.
